name: Georg Joachim
source: Georg is a Magic Weapon researcher for the Erectus army. He has done a lot of inhumane research using monsters and sorcerers. He also tends to attack neighboring villages that happen to be in the vicinity of the battlefield. He follows Blanche for some reason.
